description: One Capture per page, in page order: each member is the exact body that page's origin sent, with web.fetch's HTTP coordinate for that exchange (url is the page's built URL, request_digest covers it) plus page_index (0-based) and page_count. A page without a Capture is listed in failed_pages, and the result is then incomplete (D-R37 a4): absence never retires on it. A request with no values to page over has no pages: captures is empty and the result is complete.
name: web.fetch.pages.result
